experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an open-air sunrise yoga session overlooking the lush Campuhan valley in Ubud. The gentle morning breeze and stunning green ridge views make this a deeply restorative experience. An indoor studio session at a nearby shala is available as an alternative during rain or excessive heat.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset Walk & Swim
experiences.description: Stroll along the golden sands of Seminyak Beach during the cooler late afternoon and stay for the legendary Bali sunset. The beach is less crowded in the evening and the light is perfect for swimming and relaxation. On rainy days, explore the nearby beach clubs with covered lounging areas.

experiences.name: Yin Yoga & Sound Healing Retreat Session
experiences.description: Attend a 2-hour indoor Yin Yoga and Tibetan singing bowl sound healing session at one of Ubud's renowned wellness centers. This is an ideal midday or rainy-day activity that combines deep stretching with meditative sound therapy, perfectly suited for a 13-day wellness-focused stay.

experiences.name: Nusa Dua Snorkeling & Beach Morning
experiences.description: Head to the calm, protected waters of Nusa Dua for an early morning snorkeling session among vibrant coral reefs and tropical fish. The sheltered bay keeps waters clear and calm. Snorkeling gear rental is included. Retreat to the beachside warungs for fresh coconut and local snacks afterward.
experiences.location: Nusa Dua Beach, Nusa Dua, Bali

experiences.name: Balinese Cooking Class & Temple Visit
experiences.description: Start with an early morning visit to a local market to select fresh ingredients, then join a hands-on Balinese cooking class in a traditional open-air kitchen. Learn to prepare dishes like nasi goreng, satay lilit, and lawar. The class moves indoors if it rains. Optionally visit the nearby Tirta Empul water temple in the cooler morning hours.
